name: ORIGINAL: Blockbeard's Bounty
author: kdarius43
description: Blockbeard's Bounty is a rich Lego gameplay experience that blends pirates, sea-faring action, and surprises at every turn. Enter a chase to outfox Blockbeard, collect riches, and avoid dangers, all controlled with a single button press. Highlights feature some of the creative talent community's models showcased in game, opening and ending cutscenes recorded in a study of HDRP and visual effects graph, and additional features planned for subsequent releases.  Use spacebar to play
